title: DOW-UAP-D017, UAP Reported at Sandia Base, 1948-1950
what_is_it: A collection of correspondence and investigation documents from the Armed Forces Special Weapons Program (AFSWP) and U.S. Air Force relating to UAP sightings near Sandia Base, New Mexico, from 1948-1950.
interpretation_warnings: No OCR text was extractable from this scanned image file; all facts are derived solely from the CSV metadata description provided by war.gov, not from the document body itself.
The 209-sighting count and other details come from the government's own catalogue description and could not be independently verified against the document content.
As a scanned image collection, individual witness accounts, names, and specific dates within the 1948-1950 range are not available from this extraction.

Sandia Base was adjacent to nuclear weapons research facilities, which may contextually explain heightened surveillance and reporting but does not confirm any connection between UAP and nuclear activities.
